description: This file defines theme management for a Next.js frontend application, including context provider, theme settings, toggling modes, and applying CSS variables dynamically.

methods.name: applySettingsDom
methods.description: Applies theme settings to the DOM by updating CSS variables and injecting custom CSS links.

methods.name: ThemeProvider
methods.description: Provides theme context to child components, manages persistent theme settings, and toggles theme modes.

methods.name: useTheme
methods.description: Custom hook to access theme mode and toggle function.

methods.name: useThemeSettings
methods.description: Custom hook to access and modify theme settings.
